verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page says the open-source library adds search "at no cost" (orama-docs-12), and the APIs are designed so projects can move between Orama Cloud and Orama Open Source (orama-docs-19). That gives a self-hosted path with no per-request fees, but the pack says nothing about how Orama Cloud prices records or query volume. missing for 10: Orama Cloud pricing tiers and limits, per-request or overage policy, how costs scale with record count and query volume, independent reports on cost predictability at scale.
